rules.countMethod: Each clue individually; confirmed lower bound and conservative possible upper bound in actual active tier
rules.presentation: One name fact, one numeric fact, and two varied geography facts for every country; stored facts are alternatives, never jointly displayed.

limitations: Breadth thresholds are a practical editorial screen, not a measurement of every player's knowledge.
Starting clues are individual alternatives; combining all four stored clues can reveal a country.
Geographic match counts are confirmed minimums where sources omit disputed or overseas cases; upper bounds include conservatively possible additional matches.
Geographic facts can be shared by several countries and are not unique trivia.
